answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we also evaluate the semantic similarity between the adversarial example and the original input using the cosine similarity of Universal Sentence Encoders ) (USE).
automatic_metrics: cosine similarity of Universal Sentence Encoders (USE)

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation study of our attacks to examine to what extent are adversarial texts generated by GBDA truly imperceptible. Our interface is shown in Figure : We show annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk two snippets of text-one is not modified, and the other one is adversarially corrupted-and the annotator has to select which one is corrupted in less than 10 seconds.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown two snippets of text—one clean and one adversarially corrupted—and must select which one is corrupted within 10 seconds.
